name: Landmine Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Put one end of a barbell in a landmine anchor and load the other end. Stand at the loaded end, facing the anchor, with your feet hip width apart.
Lift the end of the bar to your hips and hold the sleeve with both hands, one hand over the other. Stand tall with your shoulders back.
With a slight bend in your knees, push your hips back and let the bar travel down in front of your thighs. Keep your back flat.
Go down until you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings, usually just below the knees.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand tall again. Do not lean back at the top.
